title: Iterated encoded sum
statement: For a Boolean string $w$, define its encoded sum by starting with the pairing of the empty string and $w$, applying the sum-step operation $(|w|+1)$ times, and extracting the first component of the resulting paired string.
caveat: The payload does not define the pairing, sum-step operation, or default component extraction.
